multi_entity_note: Two parties (drkoop.com, inc. and Vitamin Shoppe Industries, Inc.) with several addresses plus a copy-to law firm.
processing_note: Any cancellations or change orders must be made in writing and acknowledged by drkoop.com.

contract.document_name.rationale: The title and the opening sentence name it the Sponsorship Agreement; the exhibit number is not the name.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is 'entered into as of the 11th day of March, 1999'; the signature blocks are undated.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The agreement is made as of 11 March 1999 and the Term begins on 'the date set forth above'; the Launch Date qualifier is redacted and the Launch Date is a defined event, not a stated date.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The length/end of the Initial Term is redacted; no expiry date is stated (August 31, 1999 is a launch deadline).

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 9.4 applies the laws of the State of Delaware; the other Delaware/New York mentions are incorporation and address.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The Term mentions 'extensions and renewals' but no renewal term length is stated.

contract.notice_period.rationale: There is no automatic renewal and no non-renewal notice period; listed periods are termination/cure/notice-delivery periods.
